question: I got called for jury duty next month. Do I have to use my annual leave for it?
gold_answer: No. Federal employees summoned as jurors get court leave with no loss of pay or leave [5 U.S.C. 6322(a)].
author: Vijay

question: I'm in the Army Reserve. How many days of paid military leave do I get each year, and can I carry over what I don't use?
gold_answer: Reservists get 20 days of paid military leave per fiscal year (160 hours for a full-time employee), and up to 20 unused days carry over to the next fiscal year [5 U.S.C. 6323(a)(1)].
author: Vijay
verified_against: 5 U.S.C. 6323(a)(1) and OPM fact sheet: Military Leave, 21 Nov 2026

question: My brother was killed while serving in a combat zone. How much paid time off can I get to attend his funeral?
gold_answer: Up to 3 workdays of funeral leave with no loss of pay or leave, for the funeral or memorial service of an immediate relative (brothers included) who died as a result of combat-zone service [5 U.S.C. 6326(a); 5 CFR 630.803].
author: Vijay

question: I'm coming back to my federal job after a 3-month deployment supporting an overseas contingency operation. Do I get any paid time off to readjust?
gold_answer: Yes. Employees returning from at least 42 consecutive days of active duty in support of the Overseas Contingency Operations get 5 days of excused absence (paid) [OPM fact sheet: 5 Days of Excused Absence for Employees Returning from Active Military Duty].

question: I earned compensatory time off for travel on a work trip. How long do I have to use it before I lose it?
gold_answer: You must use it by the end of the 26th pay period after the pay period in which it was earned, or it is forfeited (an agency may extend this for an exigency) [5 CFR 550.1407(a)].
gold_citations: OPM fact sheet: Compensatory Time Off for Travel

question: If I have to work on a federal holiday, how am I paid for those hours?
gold_answer: You get your basic pay plus holiday premium pay equal to your rate of basic pay (double pay) for up to 8 hours of non-overtime holiday work [5 CFR 550.131(a)].
author: Vijay

question: My job requires me to wear a uniform. What's the most my agency can give me each year as a uniform allowance?
gold_answer: Up to $1,500 a year, either as an allowance or as uniforms furnished at that cost (agencies may set lower rates based on actual need) [OPM fact sheet: Uniform Allowances Fact Sheet; 5 U.S.C. 5901].

question: I got a quality step increase last spring. How soon can I get another one?
gold_answer: Not within 52 consecutive calendar weeks of the last one [5 CFR 531.505].

gold_answer: No. Separating employees get a lump-sum payment for unused annual leave only; it does not include unused sick leave [OPM fact sheet: Lump-Sum Payments For Annual Leave].

question: A coworker has a medical emergency. What's the most annual leave I can donate through the voluntary leave transfer program this year?
gold_answer: No more than one-half of the annual leave you would accrue during the leave year (less if you have use-or-lose leave) [5 CFR 630.908(a)].

question: If I'm laid off after 14 years of service, how is my severance pay worked out?
gold_answer: One week of basic pay for each full year of service up to 10 years, plus two weeks for each full year beyond 10 (here 10 + 8 = 18 weeks before any age adjustment), with a lifetime cap of 52 weeks [5 CFR 550.707].

question: I've used up all my annual leave. Can my agency advance me more, and how much?
gold_answer: At its discretion, an agency may advance annual leave up to the amount you would accrue within the leave year [OPM fact sheet: Advanced Annual Leave].

gold_answer: Yes. Short-notice deployment (notice of 7 or fewer days) is a qualifying exigency; you can take up to 7 calendar days starting on the date he was notified [5 CFR 630.1204(a)(1)].

gold_answer: The leave must have been scheduled in writing before the start of the third biweekly pay period before the end of the leave year [5 CFR 630.308(a)].

gold_answer: No. There is no limit on sick leave used for adoption-related purposes, and it does not count toward the 104-hour family care and bereavement limit [OPM fact sheet: Sick Leave for Adoption; 5 U.S.C. 6307(c)].

question: I'm full-time with 10 years of service. How many hours of annual leave will I earn over a full leave year?
gold_answer: 160 hours: 6 hours in each of 25 pay periods plus 10 hours in the last pay period [5 U.S.C. 6303(a)(2)].

question: I'm in the Senior Executive Service. How much annual leave do I earn each pay period?
gold_answer: 8 hours (1 day) per biweekly pay period, regardless of years of service [5 U.S.C. 6303(f)].
author: Vijay

question: I'm part-time with 1 year of service and had 60 hours in a pay status this pay period. How much annual and sick leave did I earn?
gold_answer: 3 hours of annual leave (1 hour per 20 hours in pay status, under 3 years of service) and 3 hours of sick leave (1 hour per 20 hours) [5 U.S.C. 6303(a); 6307(a)].

gold_answer: 60 hours: overseas employees can carry over up to 360 hours (45 days), so 420 - 360 = 60 [5 U.S.C. 6304(b)].
